verdict.rationale: Pulumi's programming-language model (loops, functions, classes) plus CLI/Automation API and MCP server enable programmatic bulk resource creation and management, and CLI probes confirm headless JSON-driven preview/apply loops suitable for AI orchestration across many resources. However, there's no dedicated bulk-operation primitive (e.g., bulk import/tag/update across arbitrary resource sets beyond per-stack declarative loops), and community feedback notes complexity managing large resource graphs and dependency issues at scale.
